definitions.explanation: Suitable for actual use rather than being decorative or theoretical. Emphasizes real-world applicability.

examples.japanese: {実用的|じつようてき}なデザインだ。
この{辞書|じしょ}は{実用的|じつようてき}で{使|つか}いやすい。
examples.english: This dictionary is practical and easy to use.

examples.japanese: {誕生日|たんじょうび}プレゼントには{実用的|じつようてき}なものを{贈|おく}るようにしている。
examples.english: I try to give practical things as birthday presents.

notes:
{実用的|じつようてき} is a na-adjective formed from {実用|じつよう} (practical use) + {的|てき} (suffix making na-adjectives).

FORMS:
- Modifier: {実用的|じつようてき}な + noun
- Adverbial: {実用的|じつようてき}に (practically, in a practical way)
- Negative: {実用的|じつようてき}ではない

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実用的|じつようてき}なデザイン (practical design)
- {実用的|じつようてき}な{知識|ちしき} (practical knowledge)
- {実用的|じつようてき}な{贈|おく}り{物|もの} (practical gift)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {便利|べんり} (convenient) focuses on ease of use, while {実用的|じつようてき} emphasizes suitability for real-world application rather than theory or decoration.
